items.title: De novo designed single-domain antibodies protect against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity in vivo
items.abstract_or_text: Generative protein design can now rapidly produce de novo binders with high affinity and functional activity against a wide range of targets, including lethal snake venom toxins. However, so far most reported successes rely on new-to-nature scaffolds with limited therapeutic precedent. Single-domain antibodies (VHHs) offer a clinically validated alternative scaffold that can bind and neutralize long-chain -neurotoxins, which are some of the most lethal components in snake venoms. Here we compare three recently established de novo design models with VHH-design capabilities (Germinal, RFantibody, and BoltzGen) for their ability to generate VHHs against the neurotoxin -cobratoxin from the monocled cobra (Naja kaouthia). Using standardized model inputs and evaluation criteria based on AlphaFold3 interface confidence (ipTM) and RMSD self-consistency, we find that Germinal was the only method to generate designs passing stringent in silico criteria for experimental testing. We therefore performed a larger Germinal design campaign employing three different VHH frameworks and experimentally validated 46 designs in vitro. Of these, 42 expressed as soluble proteins and we identified four binding hits derived from two of the three tested frameworks. Of the four binders, two lead candidates were further characterized and demonstrated high affinity (KDs of 4.1 nM and 10.8 nM), monomeric behavior and low polyreactivity, indicating favorable biophysical and developability properties, as well as functional toxin neutralization in vitro. To assess their therapeutic potential we investigated their ability to protect against -cobratoxin toxicity in vivo. Both candidates fully protected mice after -cobratoxin challenge, with 100% survival compared to a lethal control. One candidate also retained notable neutralization capacity against whole venom of Naja kaouthia with a survival of 56%, while the other protected 22% when tested in a rescue setting. Together, we demonstrate that de novo VHH design can generate high affinity single-domain antibodies with in vivo protection against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity, and provide practical insights into method- and framework-dependent performance.
items.summary_zh: 比较 Germinal、RFantibody 与 BoltzGen 的 VHH 从头设计能力，并在小鼠中验证针对眼镜蛇 α-cobratoxin 的保护作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 从生成式设计到体内毒素中和的完整证据链，为可开发的 VHH 支架用于抗蛇毒治疗提供了有力但仍属临床前的示例。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式蛋白质设计如今能够快速产生针对广泛靶标、具有高亲和力和功能活性的从头结合蛋白，其中包括致命蛇毒毒素。然而，迄今多数报道的成功案例依赖于自然界中不存在、治疗先例有限的支架。单域抗体（VHHs）提供了一种具有临床验证基础的替代支架，能够结合并中和长链 α-neurotoxins；后者是蛇毒中致死性最强的成分之一。本文比较了三种近期建立、具备 VHH 设计能力的从头设计模型（Germinal、RFantibody 和 BoltzGen）生成针对单眼眼镜蛇（Naja kaouthia）神经毒素 α-cobratoxin 的 VHH 的能力。采用标准化模型输入，以及基于 AlphaFold3 界面置信度（ipTM）和 RMSD 自洽性的评价标准后，我们发现只有 Germinal 产生了通过严格体外测试前计算筛选标准的设计。因此，我们利用三种不同的 VHH 框架开展了规模更大的 Germinal 设计活动，并在体外验证了 46 个设计。在这些设计中，42 个表达为可溶性蛋白；我们从所测试的三种框架中的两种获得了 4 个结合命中物。4 个结合蛋白中的两个先导候选物得到进一步表征，显示出高亲和力（KD 分别为 4.1 nM 和 10.8 nM）、单体行为和低多反应性，表明其具有良好的生物物理和可开发性特征，并可在体外实现功能性毒素中和。为评估治疗潜力，我们研究了它们抵御 α-cobratoxin 毒性的体内能力。两种候选物在 α-cobratoxin 攻击后均完全保护小鼠，存活率为 100%，而对照组为致死性结果。一个候选物针对 Naja kaouthia 全蛇毒仍保留明显的中和能力，存活率为 56%；另一个候选物在救援给药条件下保护了 22%。综上，从头 VHH 设计能够产生可在体内保护小鼠免受致命眼镜蛇神经毒性影响的高亲和力单域抗体，并为方法和框架依赖的性能提供了实用见解。

items.title: scMaize: A Single-Cell Foundation Model and Integrated Atlas for Maize
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell transcriptomics has resolved cell-type-specific gene expression in plants, yet maize still lacks an integrated reference and species-specific foundation models. We present scMaize, combining scMaizeAtlas, an integrated atlas of 385,675 cells from 20 projects and 66 samples across seven tissues with hierarchical annotation, with two Transformer-based foundation models pretrained on this atlas. scMaizeExp serves as an expression-only baseline, while scMaizeGO incorporates Gene Ontology (GO) functional embeddings as an inductive bias. Although global expression-prediction accuracy was comparable, the GO prior improved rank-order prediction, strengthened attention toward functionally coherent gene modules, and enhanced embedding topology, with scMaizeGO achieving 86.0% cell-type and 97.1% tissue classification accuracy. Zero-shot evaluation demonstrated the cross-species generalizability of scMaizeGO representations, and few-shot fine-tuning enabled accurate cross-species classification with minimal labeled data. Root perturbation-condition analysis showed that the model encoded treatment-specific cellular states beyond cell-type identity, with the GO prior amplifying perturbation signals approximately threefold. Expression projection identified condition-responsive genes enriched for known stress pathways, and attention analysis revealed predominantly condition-specific changes in gene-gene attention that were weakly associated with expression-projection changes. An online platform (https://www.scmaize.com) provides atlas exploration, model access, and zero-code analysis tools. scMaize establishes a framework demonstrating that species-specific pretraining with functional priors enables transferable, perturbation-aware representations for crop single-cell genomics.
items.summary_zh: scMaize 整合 385,675 个玉米单细胞并训练带 GO 功能先验的 Transformer 基础模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模植物单细胞图谱、公开平台与跨物种评估相结合，为作物细胞状态和扰动响应建模提供了可复用资源。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞转录组学已解析植物中细胞类型特异性的基因表达，但玉米仍缺乏整合参考图谱和物种特异性基础模型。我们提出 scMaize：它将 scMaizeAtlas——一个整合了 20 个项目、66 个样本、覆盖 7 种组织并具有分层注释的 385,675 个细胞图谱——与两个在该图谱上预训练的基于 Transformer 的基础模型相结合。scMaizeExp 作为仅使用表达数据的基线模型，而 scMaizeGO 将 Gene Ontology（GO）功能嵌入作为归纳偏置纳入模型。尽管全局表达预测准确性相当，GO 先验改善了排序预测，增强了模型对功能一致基因模块的注意力，并改善了嵌入拓扑；scMaizeGO 的细胞类型和组织分类准确率分别达到 86.0% 和 97.1%。零样本评估表明 scMaizeGO 表征具有跨物种泛化性，少样本微调则可在仅有极少标注数据时实现准确的跨物种分类。根部扰动条件分析显示，该模型编码了超越细胞类型身份的处理特异性细胞状态，GO 先验使扰动信号约增强三倍。表达投影识别出富集于已知胁迫通路的条件响应基因；注意力分析显示，基因—基因注意力的变化主要具有条件特异性，并且与表达投影变化的关联较弱。在线平台（https://www.scmaize.com）提供图谱浏览、模型访问和零代码分析工具。scMaize 建立了一个框架，表明具有功能先验的物种特异性预训练能够为作物单细胞基因组学提供可迁移、可感知扰动的表征。
items.author_line: Cheng, Q., Zhang, Y., Wu, H. T., Zhao, A., Shang, Q. M., Wang, F. X., Yan, J.

items.title: immgenT: A Comprehensive Reference of Convergent T-cell States in the Mouse
items.abstract_or_text: The immgenT collaborative project generated a comprehensive molecular atlas of T cells spanning virtually all mouse organs and disease states, profiling ~800,000 cells from 750 samples with RNA, 128-plex surface protein, and {beta}TCR sequence. Applying a deep generative model to joint RNA and protein data defined the landscape of T-cell states organized into eight lineages and 107 robust clusters, integrating similar cells from different contexts, and resolving prior nomenclatures. Analysis of effector molecules, transcription factors and modules showed that both immunological functions and regulatory programs are shared across cell states. This framework provides a stable, reusable reference, demonstrated by computationally integrating 16 external datasets from diverse biological contexts. A set of public web tools supports browsing of these data and mapping of any dataset onto the immgenT framework. These results propose a molecular classification of T cells organized around a set of shared states reused across immunological contexts.
items.summary_zh: immgenT 构建覆盖近乎全部小鼠器官和疾病状态的 T 细胞参考图谱，并以深度生成模型定义 8 个谱系和 107 个稳健簇。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态、大样本且可映射外部数据集的 T 细胞参考，有望提高跨实验免疫状态比较的一致性。
items.abstract_zh: immgenT 协作项目构建了一个全面的 T 细胞分子图谱，覆盖几乎所有小鼠器官和疾病状态；该项目从 750 个样本中分析了约 800,000 个细胞，检测 RNA、128-plex 表面蛋白和 βTCR 序列。将深度生成模型应用于联合 RNA 和蛋白质数据后，研究定义了由 8 个谱系和 107 个稳健簇组成的 T 细胞状态图谱，将不同背景下的相似细胞整合，并厘清既有命名体系。对效应分子、转录因子和模块的分析显示，免疫功能和调控程序均可在不同细胞状态之间共享。该框架提供了稳定、可重复使用的参考；研究通过计算整合来自多种生物学背景的 16 个外部数据集展示了其用途。一组公共网络工具支持浏览这些数据，并将任意数据集映射到 immgenT 框架。结果提出了以一组在免疫背景中重复使用的共享状态为组织原则的 T 细胞分子分类体系。

items.title: Integrative single cell analysis of CD8+ T-cells across early and advanced oral cancers reveals signatures of anti-tumour activity
items.abstract_or_text: Tumour-targeting CD8 T cells drive responses to every major form of cancer immunotherapy. Identifying them, however, remains an unsolved problem in solid tumours. The antigens they recognize are rarely defined and almost never shared between patients. We profiled 51,459 CD8+ T cells by paired single-cell RNA and T-cell receptor sequencing across 28 samples from 17 HPV-negative oral cancers spanning primary tumours, draining lymph nodes, metastases, and pembrolizumab-treated recurrences. We found that clonotypes that were expanded and shared across anatomical sites and timepoints were enriched within tumours and progressively selected over disease evolution and checkpoint blockade. Designating these shared-expanded clones as putative tumour-targeting cells, we trained a machine learning classifier that identifies them from transcriptome data alone. This 108-feature random forest signature recapitulated programmes of tumour reactivity and generalized to an integrated atlas of 89,318 CD8+ T cells from independent cohorts, showing progressive enrichment from normal to malignant tissue, and localized to tumour-proximal niches in spatial transcriptomics. By demonstrating that clonal behaviour across space and time encodes tumour reactivity in the transcriptome, this work establishes a generalizable framework for mapping tumour-engaged immunity without knowledge of the underlying antigen.
items.summary_zh: 在 17 例 HPV-negative 口腔癌的时空单细胞 RNA/TCR 数据中，以共享且扩增的克隆型定义候选肿瘤靶向 CD8+ T 细胞并训练转录组分类器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把克隆在空间和时间上的行为与转录状态联系起来，为不依赖已知抗原的肿瘤免疫细胞定位提供了候选方法。
items.abstract_zh: 靶向肿瘤的 CD8 T 细胞驱动每一种主要癌症免疫治疗形式的应答。然而，在实体瘤中识别这些细胞仍是一个未解决的问题。它们识别的抗原很少被定义，且几乎从不在患者间共享。我们在 17 例 HPV-negative 口腔癌的 28 个样本中，对 51,459 个 CD8+ T 细胞进行了配对单细胞 RNA 和 T-cell receptor 测序；样本涵盖原发肿瘤、引流淋巴结、转移灶和 pembrolizumab 治疗后的复发灶。我们发现，在解剖部位和时间点间扩增且共享的克隆型在肿瘤中富集，并在疾病演进和检查点阻断过程中受到逐步选择。将这些共享扩增克隆定义为推定肿瘤靶向细胞后，我们训练了一个机器学习分类器，仅凭转录组数据即可识别它们。这个包含 108 个特征的随机森林特征集重现了肿瘤反应性程序，并泛化至来自独立队列、整合了 89,318 个 CD8+ T 细胞的图谱，显示其从正常组织到恶性组织逐步富集，并在空间转录组学中定位于肿瘤邻近生态位。通过证明跨空间和时间的克隆行为在转录组中编码肿瘤反应性，本工作建立了一个无需了解潜在抗原即可绘制肿瘤参与型免疫的可泛化框架。
items.author_line: Li, C. H., Quah, H. S., Arcinas, C., Alagappan, L., Suteja, L., Bhuvaneswari, H., Leong, H. S., Chong, F. T., Toh, D., Wong, S., Biswas, S. K., Chan, C., Iyer, N. G.

items.title: VITAL-3D: Volumetric Single-Cell Quantification Reveals Microenvironment-Dependent Drug Responses in Breast Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Preclinical drug evaluation relies heavily on two-dimensional (2D) monolayer assays, which fail to recapitulate the structural and functional complexity of the tumor microenvironment and may therefore misrepresent therapeutic efficacy. Here, we present VITAL (Volumetric Imaging-based Toxicity and Live Analysis), a high-throughput imaging platform that enables direct single-cell quantification of proliferation and cell death in both 2D and three-dimensional (3D) extracellular matrix (ECM) cultures using a 96-well format. By combining volumetric imaging with automated single-cell analysis, VITAL enables dynamic assessment of drug responses beyond conventional viability assays and EC measurements. Using breast cancer cell lines treated with anticancer agents, we systematically compared drug responses between 2D and 3D microenvironments. Although EC values were often comparable between culture formats, growth kinetics and concentrations required to induce complete growth arrest or net cell loss differed substantially in 3D cultures. In particular, drug concentrations required to induce net cell loss were consistently higher in 3D, revealing microenvironment-dependent survival responses that were not captured by EC alone. Furthermore, clinically expected subtype-specific responses, including tamoxifen sensitivity in ER-positive cells and olaparib sensitivity in BRCA1-mutant cells, were more accurately resolved under 3D culture conditions and extended treatment durations. Together, these findings demonstrate that growth-based, single-cell quantification provides a more comprehensive assessment of therapeutic efficacy than conventional endpoint measurements and establish VITAL as a scalable platform for physiologically relevant preclinical drug screening.
items.summary_zh: VITAL 以 96 孔三维活细胞体积成像和自动单细胞分析，量化乳腺癌细胞在不同微环境中的药物反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该平台显示仅凭 EC 指标可能遗漏三维微环境中的存活反应，为更具生理相关性的临床前药筛提供了量化方案。
items.abstract_zh: 临床前药物评价严重依赖二维（2D）单层实验，但这种实验无法重现肿瘤微环境的结构和功能复杂性，因而可能错误呈现治疗疗效。本文提出 VITAL（基于体积成像的毒性与活细胞分析，Volumetric Imaging-based Toxicity and Live Analysis），这是一个高通量成像平台，采用 96 孔板形式，在二维和三维（3D）细胞外基质（ECM）培养中直接定量单细胞增殖与死亡。通过结合体积成像和自动单细胞分析，VITAL 可在传统活力检测和 EC 测量之外动态评估药物反应。利用接受抗癌药物处理的乳腺癌细胞系，我们系统比较了二维与三维微环境中的药物反应。尽管两种培养形式的 EC 值通常相近，但在三维培养中，生长动力学以及诱导完全生长停滞或细胞净减少所需的浓度存在显著差异。特别是，诱导细胞净减少所需的药物浓度在三维中始终更高，揭示了 EC 单独无法捕获的、依赖微环境的存活反应。此外，在三维培养条件和延长治疗时间下，临床上预期的亚型特异性反应得到更准确的解析，包括 ER-positive 细胞对 tamoxifen 的敏感性以及 BRCA1-mutant 细胞对 olaparib 的敏感性。综上，基于生长的单细胞定量比传统终点测量更全面地评估治疗疗效，并将 VITAL 建立为可扩展、具有生理相关性的临床前药物筛选平台。
items.author_line: Wu, P.-H., Jin, C., Chu, T., Zhang, Q., Wirtz, D.

items.title: Proteomic signatures of APOE ε4 across human tissues and cell types in Alzheimers disease
items.abstract_or_text: The apolipoprotein E {varepsilon}4 (APOE {varepsilon}4) allele is the strongest genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimers disease (AD). However, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. This study included 1691 participants from the Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project (ROSMAP), 1226 participants from the Accelerating Medicines Partnership - Alzheimers Disease (AMP-AD) Diverse Cohorts Study, and 735 participants from the Alzheimers Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). To characterise APOE {varepsilon}4 molecular effects, we analysed proteomic data from plasma, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived astrocytes and neurons, as well as transcriptomic and proteomic data from multiple brain regions. The association of APOE {varepsilon}4 with AD neuropathology was also examined. APOE {varepsilon}4 carriers shared a plasma proteomic signature enriched for immune processes, irrespective of AD diagnosis. A machine learning classifier trained on this signature discriminated APOE {varepsilon}4 carriers from non-carriers in an independent cohort using CSF proteomics. APOE {varepsilon}4 carriage was associated with higher Braak stages and Consortium to Establish a Registry for Alzheimers Disease (CERAD) score. However, only limited APOE {varepsilon}4-associated transcriptomic and proteomic changes were observed in bulk brain tissue, with poor cross-layer concordance. Proteomic analyses of iPSC-derived astrocytes and neurons further revealed cell-type-specific APOE {varepsilon}4-associated changes. APOE {varepsilon}4 is associated with a consistent proteomic signature across plasma and CSF. Its molecular effects in the brain differ across cell types, brain regions and molecular layers. These findings support the need for cell-type-resolved multi-omic studies to elucidate how APOE {varepsilon}4 confers AD risk.
items.summary_zh: 跨 ROSMAP、AMP-AD 和 ADNI 及 iPSC 细胞模型的多组织蛋白质组分析，刻画 APOE ε4 相关分子特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大队列、多体液和细胞类型证据提示 APOE ε4 作用具有组织与分子层特异性，但关联结果仍不能确定 AD 风险的机制。
items.abstract_zh: 载脂蛋白 E ε4（APOE ε4）等位基因是晚发型 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）最强的遗传风险因素。然而，其潜在分子机制仍不清楚。本研究纳入了 Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project（ROSMAP）的 1691 名参与者、Accelerating Medicines Partnership - Alzheimer’s Disease（AMP-AD）Diverse Cohorts Study 的 1226 名参与者，以及 Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative（ADNI）的 735 名参与者。为描述 APOE ε4 的分子效应，我们分析了血浆、脑脊液（CSF）和诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源星形胶质细胞及神经元的蛋白质组数据，并分析多个脑区的转录组和蛋白质组数据；同时考察 APOE ε4 与 AD 神经病理之间的关联。无论 AD 诊断状态如何，APOE ε4 携带者均共享一个富集于免疫过程的血浆蛋白质组特征。使用该特征训练的机器学习分类器可在独立队列中，依据 CSF 蛋白质组区分 APOE ε4 携带者与非携带者。APOE ε4 携带与更高 Braak 分期和 Consortium to Establish a Registry for Alzheimer’s Disease（CERAD）评分相关。然而，在整体脑组织中仅观察到有限的 APOE ε4 相关转录组和蛋白质组变化，且跨分子层的一致性较差。对 iPSC 来源星形胶质细胞和神经元的蛋白质组分析进一步显示了细胞类型特异的 APOE ε4 相关变化。APOE ε4 与在血浆和 CSF 中一致的蛋白质组特征相关；其在脑中的分子效应则随细胞类型、脑区和分子层而异。这些发现支持开展细胞类型分辨的多组学研究，以阐明 APOE ε4 如何赋予 AD 风险。
items.author_line: Li, X. C., Finney, C. A., Shvetcov, A.

items.title: Disease Spectrum Analysis and AI-Assisted Screening of Fundus Disorders Using Portable Handheld Fundus Imaging in Health Examination Populations
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Objective: Portable handheld fundus imaging facilitates convenient population‑based eye screening, yet its clinical application is hindered by unstable image quality and insufficient real‑world population disease evidence. This study aimed to establish a feasible screening workflow for handheld fundus photography in physical examination cohorts, combining standardized image quality management, population fundus disease spectrum analysis, and intelligent auxiliary disease identification to support large‑scale eye health screening. Methods: A total of 58,500 non‑mydriatic handheld fundus images were consecutively collected from a tertiary general hospital health examination center between 2020 and 2025. Automated standardized quality assessment was performed to screen valid images for subsequent analyses. Qualified high‑quality images were included to analyze the distribution characteristics of fundus diseases in the general population. Meanwhile, a two‑stage intelligent auxiliary screening strategy was implemented to identify abnormal fundus images and further categorize specific types of abnormal fundus diseases. The screening and classification performance of multiple deep learning networks was comprehensively benchmarked on handheld fundus data. Results: The overall fundus abnormality rate of high‑quality images was 32.22%. Myopia‑related fundus changes (19.84%), retinal vascular diseases (5.89%), and macular diseases (3.82%) were the predominant abnormal fundus diseases in the examined population. Distinct age‑related distribution differences were observed: younger individuals were mainly affected by myopia‑related changes, whereas elderly populations had a higher burden of vascular and macular diseases. The established intelligent system achieved favorable performance in fundus abnormality screening (AUC = 0.9612) and fine‑grained abnormal disease classification (macro‑AUC = 0.8445). Lightweight models achieved favorable performance in handheld fundus image analysis. Retinal foundation models, pre‑trained on conventional adult fundus datasets, showed limited performance advantages in this portable imaging scenario. Conclusion: Standardized quality control and intelligent auxiliary analysis may support large‑scale multi‑disease fundus screening using portable handheld imaging in routine physical examinations. The observed age‑stratified distribution pattern of fundus diseases in this health examination population provides real‑world evidence for portable fundus screening. This study presents a practical framework for population‑level fundus health surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 在 58,500 张便携式手持眼底图像中，研究标准化质控和两阶段深度学习筛查的实际表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 真实体检人群的大规模数据为便携式眼底筛查提供了早期证据；单中心、预印本结果仍需外部验证后方可判断推广价值。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的：便携式手持眼底成像有助于便捷地开展人群眼病筛查，但不稳定的图像质量和真实世界人群疾病证据不足限制了其临床应用。本研究旨在为体检队列建立一个可行的手持眼底摄影筛查流程，结合标准化图像质量管理、人群眼底疾病谱分析和智能辅助疾病识别，以支持大规模眼健康筛查。方法：在 2020 至 2025 年间，从一家三级综合医院体检中心连续收集了 58,500 张非散瞳手持眼底图像。采用自动标准化质量评估筛选有效图像，用于后续分析。纳入符合质量要求的高质量图像，分析普通人群中眼底疾病的分布特征。同时实施两阶段智能辅助筛查策略，以识别异常眼底图像并进一步分类特定类型的异常眼底疾病。在手持眼底数据上，全面基准测试多种深度学习网络的筛查和分类性能。结果：高质量图像的总体眼底异常率为 32.22%。近视相关眼底改变（19.84%）、视网膜血管疾病（5.89%）和黄斑疾病（3.82%）是受检人群中最主要的异常眼底疾病。观察到明显的年龄相关分布差异：较年轻人群主要受近视相关改变影响，而老年人群中血管和黄斑疾病负担更高。所建立的智能系统在眼底异常筛查中取得良好表现（AUC = 0.9612），在细粒度异常疾病分类中取得 macro-AUC = 0.8445。轻量化模型在手持眼底图像分析中表现良好。在传统成人眼底数据集上预训练的视网膜基础模型，在这种便携式成像场景中显示出有限的性能优势。结论：标准化质量控制和智能辅助分析可支持在常规体检中使用便携式手持成像开展大规模多病种眼底筛查。该体检人群中观察到的眼底疾病年龄分层分布模式，为便携式眼底筛查提供了真实世界证据。本研究提出了人群水平眼底健康监测的实用框架。
items.author_line: Qu Y, Jiang H, Wu K, Chen F, Yang l, Li G, Gao M

items.title: Cell-type separability predicts annotation accuracy and outweighs algorithm choice: a factorial benchmark across seven scRNA paradigms
items.abstract_or_text: Automated cell-type annotation is a prerequisite for most single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) analyses, but the rapid proliferation of methods spanning marker-based, correlation-based, classical machine-learning, deep-learning, semi-supervised, large-language-model (LLM), and transformer foundation-model paradigms has outpaced head-to-head evaluation. Existing benchmarks rely on convenience samples of real datasets in which cell count, class imbalance, cell-type number, and differential-expression strength co-vary uncontrollably, precluding causal attribution of performance to any dataset property. To resolve this, we benchmarked 63 tools across seven paradigms using a Taguchi L9(34) orthogonal array that varies four dataset properties independently, progressively reconfiguring experimental control across five phases: fully controlled simulation, within-platform and cross-platform real-data validation, database-connected and LLM-based annotation under ontology-aware scoring, and fine-tuned foundation models. Using standardized oracle inputs and Cohen's {kappa}, we found that, within the ranges tested, the major paradigms achieved comparable accuracy. Accuracy was predicted near-linearly by the separability of cell types in a shared expression embedding, measured as k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) purity, a relationship that held across sequencing platforms and in fine-tuned foundation models. We attributed the vast majority of {kappa} variance to dataset structure and only a small share to tool identity. Computational cost traded against workflow accessibility rather than accuracy: accessible correlation-based and LLM-based approaches performed competitively, while foundation models matched them only after fine-tuning. Because our oracle design isolates algorithmic capability from upstream noise, these results reframe how methods should be selected: the field's near-term gains lie in strengthening infrastructure--prioritizing tool accessibility, standardized evaluation, and robustness to pipeline variation.
items.summary_zh: 以正交设计独立操控数据集性质，在七类 scRNA-seq 标注范式中系统比较 63 种工具。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将标注性能的主要差异归因于细胞类型可分性而非工具身份，为单细胞标注的评测设计和工具选择提供了可检验依据。
items.abstract_zh: 自动细胞类型注释是多数单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）分析的前提，但标记基因、相关性、经典机器学习、深度学习、半监督、大语言模型（LLM）和 Transformer 基础模型等范式的方法快速增多，已超过了正面比较评估的速度。现有基准依赖真实数据集的便利样本，其中细胞数、类别不平衡、细胞类型数和差异表达强度无法控制地共同变化，因此无法将性能归因于任何数据集性质。为解决这一问题，我们使用 Taguchi L9(34) 正交阵列，在七个范式中基准测试 63 个工具；该阵列独立改变四项数据集属性，并在五个阶段逐步重构实验控制：完全受控模拟、平台内和跨平台真实数据验证、采用本体感知评分的数据库连接与基于 LLM 的注释，以及微调的基础模型。采用标准化 oracle 输入和 Cohen’s κ 后，我们发现，在所测试的范围内，主要范式达到了相当的准确率。准确率几乎可线性地由共享表达嵌入中细胞类型的可分性预测，该可分性以 k-nearest-neighbor（kNN）纯度衡量；这一关系跨测序平台成立，也在微调基础模型中成立。我们将绝大多数 κ 方差归因于数据集结构，仅将很小部分归因于工具身份。计算成本与工作流可及性之间存在权衡，而非与准确率之间的权衡：易用的基于相关性和基于 LLM 的方法具有竞争力，基础模型只有在微调后才与之匹配。由于 oracle 设计将算法能力与上游噪声隔离，这些结果重新界定了方法选择：该领域近期的提升应来自加强基础设施，优先发展工具可及性、标准化评价和对流程变化的稳健性。
items.author_line: Wardhana, O., Zeng, Z., Lu, X.

items.title: Disease Burden over Skin Tone: Decomposing the Dermatology-AI Generalization Gap
items.abstract_or_text: Dermatology artificial intelligence (AI) models are predominantly trained on light-skinned, cancer-focused image collections, yet they are increasingly proposed for deployment in resource-constrained settings where patients differ from training populations along two confounded axes: skin tone and disease distribution. We investigate whether poor generalization is primarily caused by skin-tone underrepresentation or disease-distribution shift. We evaluate a cancer-trained baseline (ResNet-50 fine-tuned on HAM10000 and ISIC 2019), two dermatology foundation models (DermLIP and MONET), and a general-purpose vision model (DINOv3) as frozen feature extractors. Models are evaluated on a tone-stratified disease-matched dataset (Diverse Dermatology Images, DDI) and a disease-shifted tone-diverse dataset (Skin Condition Image Network, SCIN). Our results show that disease-distribution shift contributes more than skin tone in the evaluated settings. The cancer baseline decreases from 0.62 to 0.21 balanced accuracy when transferred to unfamiliar clinical conditions, while the within-disease skin-tone gap is smaller (0.10-0.18) and inconsistent. Label-free representation analysis shows that this failure reflects a representational limitation rather than only missing output labels: cancer-specialized features poorly cluster unfamiliar conditions (kNN purity lift +0.06 over chance), whereas dermatology-pretrained features retain stronger transferable structure (+0.23). Finally, we show that representation quality predicts recoverable performance under lightweight adaptation. Starting from dermatology foundation models, approximately ten labeled examples per clinical category recover most attainable performance. We release the evaluation protocol and code to support reproducible auditing of dermatology AI generalization.
items.summary_zh: 比较癌症训练模型、皮肤科基础模型与通用视觉模型在肤色匹配及疾病分布迁移场景中的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提示所评估条件下疾病分布转移较肤色代表性不足更显著地限制泛化，为皮肤科 AI 的公平性审计提出更具体的问题框架。
items.abstract_zh: 皮肤科人工智能（AI）模型主要在浅肤色、以癌症为中心的图像集合上训练，但它们越来越多地被提议部署于资源受限地区；这些地区的患者与训练人群沿两条相互混杂的轴不同：肤色和疾病分布。我们研究泛化不佳主要由肤色代表性不足还是疾病分布转移造成。我们评估了一个癌症训练基线模型（在 HAM10000 和 ISIC 2019 上微调的 ResNet-50）、两个皮肤科基础模型（DermLIP 和 MONET），以及作为冻结特征提取器的通用视觉模型 DINOv3。模型在肤色分层、疾病匹配的数据集 Diverse Dermatology Images（DDI）和疾病转移、肤色多样的数据集 Skin Condition Image Network（SCIN）上评估。结果显示，在所评估的条件下，疾病分布转移的贡献大于肤色。癌症基线模型迁移到不熟悉的临床情况时，平衡准确率从 0.62 降至 0.21；而疾病内的肤色差距较小（0.10–0.18）且不一致。无标签表征分析显示，这一失败反映了表征能力限制，而不仅仅是缺少输出标签：癌症专门化特征难以聚类不熟悉疾病（相较随机水平的 kNN purity 提升为 +0.06），而皮肤科预训练特征保留了更强的可迁移结构（+0.23）。最后，我们显示表征质量可预测轻量级适配下可恢复的性能。以皮肤科基础模型为起点，每个临床类别约 10 个带标注例子即可恢复大部分可达到的性能。我们发布评估协议和代码，以支持对皮肤科 AI 泛化能力的可复现审计。
items.author_line: Nirajan Kunwor, Sanjaya Poudel, Quoc-Huy Trinh, Jahidul Arafat, Sunil Kumar Gaire

items.title: MetaClaw: an auditable AI agent for end-to-end, multi-directional metagenomic and multi-omics analysis
items.abstract_or_text: End-to-end omics analysis requires more than selecting tools: a usable agent must bind data correctly, execute long workflows without blocking, preserve provenance and recover the biological conclusions that motivate an analysis. Existing LLM-driven bioinformatics agents automate parts of this process, but their operational dependencies and conclusion-level validity are often unclear. Here we present MetaClaw, an auditable agent that maps a user request to a registered workflow, executes standardized upstream processing on FlowHub, and runs study-specific downstream analyses in network-isolated OpenClaw containers. A YAML registry and an explicit plan-submit-poll-finalise lifecycle record file bindings, parameters, scripts, environments and outputs in per-job bundles. Across the full cohorts of four published studies (769 metagenomic profiles), MetaClaw recovered 4/4 sorghum marker groups, 3/3 RRMS features, 4/5 canonical CRC markers among the top 20 classifier features and 5/5 permafrost marker groups. In 45 model-by-prompt runs, upstream completion was consistent whereas downstream validity depended on the backend and instruction detail; three decoy-tested endpoints showed no significant differences. In 48 ablation sessions, removing the registry, planning loop or manifest caused distinct losses, with registry removal increasing time, tool calls and token cost. MetaClaw therefore connects standardized upstream execution, local analytical flexibility and conclusion-level validation in a rerunnable framework for metagenomic and microbiome multi-omics analysis.
items.summary_zh: MetaClaw 将注册工作流、FlowHub 上游处理、隔离容器内下游分析和每任务可审计记录结合，用于宏基因组与多组学分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它在四项已发表研究中重现多项已知信号，并报告提示敏感性，强调生物信息智能体应同时报告流程出处与结论层面的有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 端到端组学分析不只是选择工具：可用的智能体必须正确绑定数据、在不中断的情况下执行长流程、保留出处信息，并恢复推动分析的生物学结论。现有 LLM 驱动的生物信息智能体能够自动化这一过程的部分环节，但其运行依赖和结论层面的有效性常不明确。本文提出 MetaClaw，这是一个可审计智能体：它将用户请求映射到已注册工作流，在 FlowHub 上执行标准化上游处理，并在网络隔离的 OpenClaw 容器中运行研究特异性的下游分析。YAML 注册表和显式的 plan-submit-poll-finalise 生命周期在每个任务包中记录文件绑定、参数、脚本、环境和输出。MetaClaw 在四项已发表研究的完整队列中分析了 769 个宏基因组图谱，恢复了 4/4 个高粱标记组、3/3 个 RRMS 特征、分类器前 20 个特征中的 4/5 个经典 CRC 标记，以及 5/5 个永久冻土标记组。在 45 次模型—提示词运行中，上游完成情况一致，而下游有效性取决于后端和指令细节；三个诱饵测试端点未显示显著差异。在 48 次消融会话中，移除注册表、规划循环或清单均造成不同损失；移除注册表会增加时间、工具调用和 token 成本。因此，MetaClaw 在一个可重复运行的框架中连接了标准化上游执行、本地分析灵活性和结论层面的验证，用于宏基因组和微生物组多组学分析。
items.author_line: Zhang, H., Li, Z., Lagniton, P. N. P., Wang, Z., Zhao, L., Li, W., Duan, p., Jiang, X., Ning, K.

items.title: Improving Health Literacy through Lay Summarization of Radiological Reports: An Evaluation of BioNER and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Radiology reports are written primarily for clinicians, and their specialized terminology often makes them difficult for patients to interpret. As a result, many patients turn to publicly available Large Language Models (LLMs) to help explain their reports, despite well-documented risks of factual inaccuracies and hallucinations. Automated lay-summary generation has emerged as a promising alternative, yet the effectiveness of retrieval-enhanced and clinically informed approaches for radiology-specific communication remains underexplored. This study investigates the extent to which Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Named Entity Recognition (NER) improve the quality, factual consistency, and readability of automatically generated lay summaries compared with standard LLM-based generation. We develop a framework combining NER-based extraction of clinically relevant findings with a RAG mechanism for contextual grounding, evaluated across few-shot and fine-tuned variants of two models (Qwen, BioBART). Results show that NER consistently improves readability and overall quality, while RAG alone offers no benefit and can introduce hallucinations from irrelevant retrieved terms. Combining RAG with NER degrades performance in few-shot settings but improves readability when fine-tuned. Fine-tuned BioBART with NER achieves the best overall performance, highlighting entity-aware extraction as the primary driver of improved patient-friendly summaries.
items.summary_zh: 比较 Qwen 和 BioBART 在少样本和微调设置下，BioNER 与 RAG 对放射学报告患者友好摘要的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示实体识别是改善可读性和总体质量的主要因素，RAG 单独使用可能引入幻觉，为患者信息生成的系统设计提供了警示。
items.abstract_zh: 放射学报告主要为临床医生撰写，其专业术语常使患者难以理解。因此，许多患者转而使用公开可用的大语言模型（LLMs）来解释报告，尽管此类模型存在已有充分记录的事实错误和幻觉风险。自动生成通俗摘要已成为一种有前景的替代方案，但针对放射学交流，检索增强和临床知情方法的有效性仍缺乏研究。本研究考察了与标准 LLM 生成相比，Retrieval-Augmented Generation（RAG）和 Named Entity Recognition（NER）在多大程度上提高自动通俗摘要的质量、事实一致性和可读性。我们开发了一个框架，将基于 NER 的临床相关发现提取与用于上下文依据的 RAG 机制相结合，并在两个模型（Qwen、BioBART）的少样本和微调变体中评估。结果显示，NER 始终改善可读性和总体质量；RAG 单独使用没有益处，还可能由不相关的检索术语引入幻觉。在少样本设置中，将 RAG 与 NER 结合会降低性能，但在微调后可改善可读性。采用 NER 的微调 BioBART 取得了最佳总体表现，表明实体感知提取是改善患者友好摘要的主要驱动因素。
items.author_line: Egecan Çelik Evgin, İlknur Karadeniz, Olcay Taner Yıldız

review.note: 精选 11 项，均为 preprint。临床相关研究多为回顾性数据分析或基准评估，尚不足以改变临床实践。
